basic_details.job_title: ICMR Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Research Assistant, Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.short_information: The ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health, Mumbai, has invited online applications for 1 Research Assistant and 2 Field Investigator posts in the "National level multicentric study on costing of health services (CHSI 2.0)", funded by the Department of Health Research (DHR). content_sections.heading: About ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health
content_sections.text: The institute is an ICMR institute at Jehangir Merwanji Street, Parel, Mumbai 400012. These posts serve the CHSI 2.0 study, a national level multicentric study on costing of health services funded by the Department of Health Research.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 vacancies in two posts, each with its own Job ID. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states that candidates meeting the eligible qualification should only apply. The age limit is 40 years for Research Assistant and 35 years for Field Investigator. The notice prints no age relaxation and no date for counting age. Understanding of Health system costing, cost data collection. Experience in public health data management and analysis. Experience in household or facility level data collection in health care research. Experience of field work in health sector involving cost data collection in facilities. Good computer knowledge. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduation in Science with MPH/MBA in Health Care Management & Hospital Administration, with 1 years of work experience in relevant field from a recognized institution/organisation.

Graduate in Science/relevant subjects from a recognized university with 3 years of work experience from a recognized institution, OR Master's degree in the relevant subject (MSW/MPH/MBA in health care management & Hospital Administration).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant post carries consolidated salary of Rs.50,000/- and the Field Investigator post Rs.35,000/-. Both posts are for six months and are to be filled on a purely temporary basis. The notice names no allowances.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Support the Principal Investigator and study team in planning and executing healthcare costing data collection across public and private healthcare facilities. Oversee the cleaning, validation, and management of health economics datasets while ensuring strict confidentiality and compliance with DHR/ICMR guidelines. Conduct statistical analyses, assist with modeling, draft technical/progress reports, and coordinate field deployments, training workshops, and stakeholder communications. Any other work as assigned by PI. Conduct field visits across health facilities and hospitals to collect primary quantitative, qualitative, and cost data through staff interviews, while maintaining field documentation and adhering to mandatory research ethics protocols. Any other work as assigned by PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the application link https://gad-hrms.frevo.co.in/careers , run by the outsourcing agency M/s. GA Digital Web Word Pvt. Ltd. Apply for the post you are eligible for: Job ID JOB-6691390EF20149678E1163D358D9FE7C is for Research Assistant and Job ID JOB-713F9A488C3A480FA40C40890212B5BD is for Field Investigator. Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps or name any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews, which may be physical or online. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview details later. The notice gives no interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are invited through the outsourcing agency M/s. GA Digital Web Word Pvt. Ltd. The posts are to be filled on a purely temporary basis. Only candidates meeting the eligible qualification should apply.
